title: Writing: A typical day
goal: Write about your daily routine with the present simple, frequency adverbs and the present continuous.
goal_it: Scrivere della tua routine con present simple, avverbi di frequenza e present continuous.

steps.title: Today: writing about your typical day
steps.title_it: Oggi: scrivere della tua giornata tipica
en: Today you will learn the words for a daily routine, read a model text, and then write your own.
You will use the present simple for routines, frequency adverbs like usually and never, and the present continuous for what you are doing now.
it: Oggi impari le parole della routine quotidiana, leggi un testo modello e poi scrivi il tuo.
Userai il present simple per le routine, gli avverbi di frequenza come usually e never, e il present continuous per ciò che stai facendo adesso.

steps.title: Daily routine words
en: Learn these ten expressions. They are in your flashcards too.
it: Impara queste dieci espressioni. Le trovi anche nelle flashcard.

steps.title: A model text
en: I'm Marta and I live in Pescara. I usually get up at seven, and I have breakfast at half past seven. I start work at nine and I finish at five. In the evening I often cook dinner, and I sometimes go for a walk. At the weekend I never set an alarm. Right now I'm writing about my day.
it: Sono Marta e vivo a Pescara. Di solito mi alzo alle sette e faccio colazione alle sette e mezza. Inizio a lavorare alle nove e finisco alle cinque. La sera spesso preparo la cena e a volte faccio una passeggiata. Nel fine settimana non metto mai la sveglia. In questo momento sto scrivendo della mia giornata.

steps.title: Checklist before you write
en: Use this list to check every sentence.
it: Usa questa lista per controllare ogni frase.

head: Check
Example
rows: Negative and question: does / doesn't, no -s on the verb
He doesn't have lunch at home.
Frequency adverb before the main verb, after am / is / are
I usually walk. I am always tired.
at seven, on Monday, in the evening

steps.why: We say have breakfast, have lunch, have dinner.
steps.why_it: Si dice have breakfast, have lunch, have dinner.

steps.q: I ___ to work by bus every day.
steps.q_it: Vado al lavoro in autobus ogni giorno.
steps.why: Every day shows a routine, so we use the present simple. With I: go.
steps.why_it: Every day indica una routine, quindi present simple. Con I: go.

steps.q: She ___ (get) up at six every day.
steps.q_it: Lei si alza alle sei ogni giorno.

steps.why: Negative: doesn't + base verb. No -s on have.
steps.why_it: Negativa: doesn't + verbo base. Niente -s su have.

answers: I usually start work at nine
steps.why: The adverb usually goes before the main verb.
steps.why_it: L'avverbio usually va prima del verbo principale.

answers: She never goes to bed before midnight
steps.why: Never goes before the main verb. With she: goes.
steps.why_it: Never va prima del verbo principale. Con she: goes.

options: I always am tired on Monday.
I am always tired on Monday.
Always I am tired on Monday.
I am tired always on Monday.
steps.why: With am / is / are the adverb goes after the verb: I am always.
steps.why_it: Con am / is / are l'avverbio va dopo il verbo: I am always.

steps.q: We have a big lunch ___ Sunday.
steps.q_it: Facciamo un grande pranzo la domenica.

steps.q: I read a book ___ the evening.
steps.why: Parts of the day take in: in the evening.
steps.why_it: Le parti del giorno vogliono in: in the evening.

steps.q: Right now I ___ a text about my day.
steps.q_it: In questo momento sto scrivendo un testo sulla mia giornata.
steps.why: Right now means at this moment: present continuous.
steps.why_it: Right now significa in questo momento: present continuous.

steps.why: Negative with she: doesn't + base verb.
steps.why_it: Negativa con she: doesn't + verbo base.

answers: Does he usually walk to work

steps.why: With she we say has, not have: She has breakfast at eight.
steps.why_it: Con she si dice has, non have: She has breakfast at eight.

steps.title: Your writing task
en: Write six sentences about your typical day. Use at least three frequency adverbs, two times with at, and one sentence in the present continuous.
Write on paper or in your notes app. This app does not correct your text, so read it again with the checklist and check each sentence.
If you want, share your text with a friend from the class and compare.
it: Scrivi sei frasi sulla tua giornata tipica. Usa almeno tre avverbi di frequenza, due orari con at e una frase al present continuous.
Scrivi su carta o nell'app note. L'app non corregge il testo, quindi rileggilo con la checklist e controlla ogni frase.
Se vuoi, condividi il testo con un amico della classe e confrontatelo.

cards.ex: I sometimes go for a walk.
She goes to bed at eleven.
I never set an alarm at the weekend.
